test_results.observation: Missing, invalid and disabled credentials returned UNAUTHENTICATED, while valid cross-Workspace principals returned WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED before ingestion or question application calls. Matching principals retained the normal application seam.
CLI ingestion wrote only to its explicit Workspace. A mismatched Workspace Principal was rejected by the shared IngestDocument seam before provider work or persistence.

A late ingestion returned DOCUMENT_CONCURRENTLY_UPDATED after a newer ingestion committed. The winner retained the active pointer and revision, the failed transaction left no Document Version, Chunk Set or Embedding Set, and a fresh retry succeeded.

PostgreSQL rejected same-Workspace cross-Document, cross-Workspace, incomplete and wrong-configuration active assignments. Active sets could not become incomplete or be deleted, and rejected mutations preserved the prior pointer and revision.
